title: Multi-XScience: A Large-scale Dataset for Extreme Multi-document Summarization of Scientific Articles

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the percentage of novel n-grams in the target summaries and evaluating an extractive oracle (EXT-ORACLE) baseline using ROUGE scores to measure how much models can achieve high performance by simply copying input sentences.
Evaluating a LEAD baseline using ROUGE scores, which selects the first-K sentences from the source documents, to determine the dataset's reliance on fixed positional cues.
